question: What will be the result of the CD Eldense vs Real Oviedo LaLiga Hypermotion match on 2 October 2026?

calls.reasoning: Segunda's league-wide split is roughly 41% home / 29% draw / 30% away; conditioning on a bottom-six home side against a mid-table visitor moves it to about 35/29/36, which is my anchor. Eldense (5 pts, 4 GF in 6, manager changed 16 Sep, lost Calleja's debut) are weaker on the table than Oviedo (8 pts, 5 GF / 4 GA), but Oviedo are themselves a newly relegated side that finished last in LaLiga and just shipped three at Sabadell, so home advantage roughly offsets the quality gap - a near-even match rather than an away-favourite one. I nudge the draw above the reference class (0.31) because both attacks are among the division's weakest in a league scoring only 2.47 goals/match, and an independent-Poisson check at ~1.05 v ~1.15 expected goals gives ~29-31% draw before any low-score correction; Oviedo drew 11 of 38 LaLiga matches last season. The only market candidates are zero-volume Polymarket contracts (0.36/0.28/0.36) whose fetched pages were internally inconsistent, so they corroborate the near-even shape without justifying much movement off my own estimate. Both teams play one more round on 27 Sep, so form and injuries could still shift this materially.

calls.reasoning: Unconditional Segunda split is ~41/29/30 home/draw/away; conditioning on a bottom-six home side hosting a better-placed visitor moves it to roughly 34/29/37, which is my anchor. Two reconciled facts push slightly further toward Oviedo: the table gap is real and current (both clubs' listed results reconcile exactly to the official MD6 GF/GA/points lines, including Oviedo's 1-3 at Sabadell), and the squad-quality gap is larger than 3 points suggests - Oviedo came down from LaLiga with a top-flight budget and are outshooting opponents 12.4 to Eldense's 7.8, while Eldense appear to be a side only just promoted back from Primera Federacion. Offsetting that: Oviedo have scored zero goals in three home matches and both first-choice strikers missed time in September, and Eldense get home advantage under a brand-new coach. The draw sits a couple of points above the reference class because both attacks are far below the 2.47 goals/match league rate (9 goals combined in 12 games) - an independent Poisson at ~1.05 v ~1.10 expected goals gives ~29.5% before a low-score correction, ~31% after - and the last four meetings produced three draws. The only market candidates are three Polymarket contracts whose wording does match this question's terms (90 min + stoppage, official LaLiga source, postponement keeps it open), but they show $0 volume and price 36/28/36 summing to exactly 1.00 with no vig - a seeded book, not a traded one, so it is corroboration of the near-even shape rather than an anchor. No Kalshi, Manifold or bookmaker 1X2 line was retrievable by any run.
calls.reconciliation: Disputes were narrow; all three runs landed within 2 points of each other on every option. (1) Eldense 0-2 vs 1-2 Eibar: settled by arithmetic - only 1-2 reconciles with the official GF 4 / GA 8 line. (2) Whether the official GA column lagged a round for Oviedo: settled against Run 1 - their six results sum to exactly GF 5 / GA 4, so Sabadell is included. (3) Oviedo's league position (7th per the question background, 13th per Runs 2-3): unsettled without web access, but immaterial - all sources agree on 8 points from 6 games, and points, not the ordinal, drive the estimate. (4) Whether Eldense are an 'established second-division side' (background) or newly promoted from Primera Federacion (Run 3): could not be settled this run, but Run 3's account is internally coherent (19th in 2024/25 = relegated, so 2025/26 in the third tier). I let it carry partial weight only, which is why I sit 1 point below the runs on the home option rather than further. (5) The 'Leo Messi at Eldense' item: Run 1 flagged it as source noise, Run 3 reported it as a completed purchase pending CSD authorisation. Unresolvable here and non-diagnostic for a single match result either way - I gave it zero weight. (6) A search-summary claim that the match finished 2-1 was correctly discarded by Run 2: every primary page shows it Scheduled/'Por jugar'. Remaining disagreement is pure judgment - how much of the 3-point table gap is real talent versus 6-game noise - and I take the reading that the relegated side's underlying volume corroborates a genuine but modest edge, landing me at the away-leaning end of the runs' range.
